Economics (B.A.)
- ECON-UA 1 Introduction to Macroeconomics (P/T) (4 cr)
- ECON-UA 2 Introduction to Microeconomics (4 cr)
- ECON-UA 18 Statistics (4 cr)
- ECON-UA 10 Interm Microeconomics (4 cr) or ECON-UA 11 Microeconomic Analysis
- ECON-UA 12 Interm Macroeconomics (4 cr) or ECON-UA 13 Macroeconomic Analysis
- ECON-UA 266 Intro to Econometrics (4 cr)
- Select one of the following: (4 cr): ECON-UA 227 Urban Economics; ECON-UA 231 Money and Banking; ECON-UA 238 International Economics
- Select three ECON-UA electives (at least two must be 300-level) (12 cr)
- ECON-UA 410 Honors Tutorial (4 cr)
- ECON-UA 450 Honors Thesis (4 cr)
